intro.title: Rose Quartz Stone
intro.description: Rose Quartz has been considered the crystal of love for several centuries. The soothing beauty and color makes this stone popular amongst people and jewelers alike. Rose Quartz has been used by ancient Egyptians, Romans and Greeks for its healing and other mystic properties on the body, heart and mind. Evidence of rose quartz's long and storied history in jewelry use comes from the discovery of beads made of the gemstone in Mesopotamia (modern-day Iraq) that date back to 7,000 B.C.

tabs.tab2_heading: Who should wear Rose Quartz gemstone?
tabs.tab1_description:
Rose Quartz gemstone is the rose-colored variety of the mineral quartz, which is abundantly found all over the world in very large specimens. Rose Quartz stones are found in different shades of pink, ranging from translucent to deep pink. This stone gets its color from metal oxides, manganese and titanium. Its hardness is 7 Mohs, this makes rose quartz a stone that is easy to work with because it is very resistant. The density of this stone is 2.65. Rose Quartz is mainly formed in magmatic rocks, such as pegmatites.

In the time of the Pharaohs, Rose Quartz had the reputation of fighting against skin aging. The Egyptians used it in powder to eliminate wrinkles. For the ancient Romans and Greeks, Rose Quartz came from the love gods Amor and Eros. The pink hue of Rose Quartz is soft and soothing, thus it is believed that it helps reduce stress. The softness of Rose Quartz is also beneficial for the skin. The stone is used directly in contact with the skin to soothe burns. This stone also played an important role in the healing process of the body. This healing stone symbolizes unconditional love and brings security, peace and comfort.

As a stone of love, rose quartz is a potent crystal for those who wish to attract more love into their lives. The healing properties of rose quartz are associated with the Hrit Padma chakra or sacred heart chakra, the pivotal center of love. By revealing and healing your sacred heart center, the rose quartz chakra assists you in deepening relationships and embracing self-compassion, compassion, tenderness, and love.

Rose quartz is known as the love stone, as it activates the sacred heart chakra to facilitate unconditional love, sensuality, and attractiveness. Its delicate pink hues have made it the ideal token of affection. It is believed to restore confidence in a relationship and makes the ideal present for a loved one.

Rose quartz is also a cool crystal that induces pleasant visions and banishes nightmares. It is also a tranquil and relaxing crystal that is particularly useful during times of trauma or tension.

Rose quartz is also strongly associated with feminine energy and is believed to contain forces of warmth, compassion, tenderness, and nurturing.

It is highly sought after by Feng Shui practitioners.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although Rose Quartz gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing Rose Quartz. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Hrit Padma Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for relief from stress, peace of mind and calmness.

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses with a feeling of soothing and relaxing effect. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.

Rose Quartz is an excellent sleep stone for adults and children, as it promotes pleasant dreams and prevents nightmares and night terrors. Moreover, it helps children overcome their fear of the dark.

Rose quartz is a calming and comforting crystal that is ideal for use in times of trauma or crisis, such as the emotional turmoil of a midlife crisis. It enhances empathy and sensitivity and facilitates the acceptance of required change. Also, it is a great stone for soothing grief and enhancing openness to new love experiences.

A large piece of unpolished Rose Quartz provides ongoing protection against intrusion and gossip in the workplace. Moreover, it is a support stone for beauty advisors.

Important Details:

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Rose Quartz gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Rose Quartz gemstones.

 

Rose Quartz Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

Brazil is the primary source of rose quartz, with India and Sri Lanka having main deposits of rose quartz. They are also found in Madagascar, Mozambique, Germany, the United States and South West Africa.

Observe their Color:

Rose Quartz is available in a wide range of pink tones, from light to dark. For use in jewelry, gemstones with vivid hues are the most desired, while rarer shades of deep pink are the most desired.

Notice their Clarity:

Rose quartz is typically translucent and appears milky and hazy. It is never completely clear.

Examine their Inclusions:

Most rose quartz has a translucent appearance due to minute inclusions. Transparent rose quartz of the highest quality is typically faceted.

See their Shape:

Rose Quartz can be fashioned into a variety of gemstone shapes, including uncommon shapes such as Asscher, emerald, rose cut, etc., although this is done much less frequently and typically only with transparent varieties.

Check the Carats:

For Rose Quartz of gem quality, the raw Rose Quartz is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Rose Quartz weighing between 10 and 20 carats are appropriate for jewelry. Because Rose Quartz is sold by weight, Rose Quartz prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Rose Quartz has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Rose Quartz

Due to treatments the Rose Quartz stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Rose Quartz do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate

It is recommended that you should purchase Rose Quartz gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Rose Quartz are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Rose Quartz from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Rose Quartz gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Rose Quartz gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Rose Quartz is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity).

Color

The best quality rose quartz stones are pure pink in color with vivid and vibrant color saturation and tone that is not too dark or light. The color should be evenly distributed with no visible color-zone.

Cut

Best quality Rose Quartz stones have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, saturation and surface area.

Carat

Rose Quartz of 10 – 20 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Rose Quartz are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Rose Quartz rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

Rose quartz of premium quality displays a high degree of transparency. Rose quartz with least inclusions and best clarity are considered the best.

Dealers deal in Rose quartz which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.

Rose Quartz Gemstone Price

The price of Rose Quartz gemstone depends on its size, its cut, as well as its origin in terms of color, cut and clarity. The Pink Madonna, one of the largest and most renowned rose quartz specimens, was sold at auction for over USD 500,000 some years ago. It measured close to 40 centimeters in height and is recognized as one of the most expensive precious minerals ever auctioned. Nevertheless, because rose quartz is affordable and plentiful, there is no reason not to include it in your jewelry collection.

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Rose Quartz has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Rose Quartz stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Rose Quartz gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 420 to INR 9,075 (USD 5 to USD 113.44).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Rose Quartz?

The best way to check the authenticity of Rose Quartz is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Rose Quartz are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Rose Quartz carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Rose Quartz is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Rose Quartz have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Rose Quartz, but if you find flaws, then your Rose Quartz is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Rose Quartz are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Rose Quartz. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Rose Quartz, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Rose Quartz from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Rose Quartz. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Rose Quartz. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Rose Quartz Cleaning & Maintenance

It is essential to give your gemstone a thorough cleaning in order to preserve its luster, as regular use can cause it to become dull. This washing enables it to purge itself from negative energies as well.

Your rose quartz gemstone might routinely carry negative energies, and the stone or ring can be detoxified by dipping it in water overnight, and in a bowl full of quartz crystals for another night.

The Rose quartz gemstones can be washed with mild water and then dried off with a soft cloth, but not being a very hard mineral, it should be avoided from cuts or scratches.

Avoid using ultrasonic cleaners on rose quartz, as they can damage it.
